drive.physics_forced: Physics is always on for driven props on this server
drive.physics_disabled: Physics is off for driven props on this server
drive.title: Prop Driving
server.gravity.description: How fast everything falls, in inches per second squared. 850 is the default. Props changed with the gravity tool scale from this.
server.keepcorpses.players.description: Player corpses stay until a cleanup instead of despawning.
server.keepcorpses.npcs.description: NPC corpses stay until a cleanup instead of despawning.
server.noclip_speed.description: Multiplier on how fast players fly in noclip.
server.allow.godmode.description: Players can toggle god mode for themselves with the god command. Admins and players with the God Mode permission always can.
server.allow.pvp.description: Players can damage each other with weapons, explosions, vehicles and the props they throw.
server.allow.noclip.description: Players can toggle noclip with its key or the noclip command. Admins and players with the Noclip permission always can.
server.noclip_disabled: Noclip is disabled on this server
server.ownership.checks.description: Players can only physgun, toolgun and pick up their own props. Admins can touch anything.
server.reequiplast.description: Give players back the weapons they were carrying when they respawn.
server.falldamage_realistic.description: When enabled, fall damage scales with how fast you hit the ground.
server.spawnprotection.description: Seconds of invulnerability after spawning. 0 turns it off.
server.carry.description: Players can pick up light props with use.
server.carry.maxmass.description: The heaviest prop, in kg, players can pick up with use.
server.allow.drive.description: Players can drive props from the Inspector. Admins and players with the Drive Props permission always can.
server.drive.physics.description: Whether driven props collide and fall, with jump to jump. Per-Player lets each player toggle it with the noclip key, on to start with.
server.drive.speed.description: How fast driven props move, in inches per second.
server.drive.sprint.description: How much faster driven props go while holding run.
server.developer.entities.description: Show developer entities in the spawn menu.
spawner.name: Spawner
server.limit.props.description: Maximum props per player. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none allowed.
server.limit.explosives.description: Maximum explosive props per player. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none allowed.
server.limit.balloons.description: Maximum balloons per player. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none allowed.
server.limit.constraints.description: Maximum constraints per player. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none allowed.
server.limit.emitters.description: Maximum emitters per player. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none allowed.
server.limit.thrusters.description: Maximum thrusters per player. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none allowed.
server.limit.hoverballs.description: Maximum hoverballs per player. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none allowed.
server.limit.wheels.description: Maximum wheels per player. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none allowed.
server.limit.texts.description: Maximum placed texts per player. -1 = unlimited, 0 = none allowed.
